newsitem.title: PERU: Japan signs $500 mln loan with Peru - Fujimori.
newsitem.headline: Japan signs $500 mln loan with Peru - Fujimori.

text.p: Peru's President Alberto Fujimori said he signed Tuesday with Japan's Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto a package of loans worth around $500 million from Tokyo and payable over ten years.
"This is a concessional loan with preferential treatment," said Fujimori, adding that the money would be used for hydroelectric and environmental programs.
He said the credits were payable over seven to 10 years at interest rates varying from 2.2 percent to 2.7 percent.
Fujimori was speaking after an hour-long meeting with Hashimoto at Lima's Government Palace during the Japanese Premier's penultimate leg of a 10-day Latin American tour.
